summary: reg.exe added a Run key that would start a program at every logon. The change was not approved, so the key was removed. reg.exe had already exited, so nothing was suspended.

techniques.name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
techniques.evidence: reg.exe set the value AtomicTest under the HKCU Run key, and FIM confirmed it differs from the baseline.

timeline: 09:33:00 reg.exe wrote the AtomicTest Run value
09:33:01 FIM reported the value as added
09:33:01 The value was removed to restore the baseline
